protocol.source_text:
presentation < 1 hour post ingestion 
* NB Do not discharge even if asymptomatic! Must be monitored for 72 hours. 
Super-warfarins may require WEEKS of Vit K therapy 
RISK STRATIFICATION IF ANTI-COAGULATION IS REVERSED 
High: mechanical valve, especially mitral valve 
Moderate: AF/cardiomyopathy with valvular disease/previous CVA/MI/embolism/CCF, multiple PE/DVT, 
biological valve < 3/12, DVT < 2/12, lab-confirmed hypercoagulability + DVT/PE, prev arterial emboli 
Low: AF/Cardiomyopathy with no complications, biological valve > 3/12, vascular prosthetic grafts, post 
stent insertion, mural thrombus prophylaxis
